classification: outcome-informed architecture calibration on frozen T-071A seeds; design evidence only

controller.rho_cap_interpretation: separated mixing class lambda<=0.95; not unrestricted unknown mixing

descriptive_criteria.P1: finite complete reuse of all 432 cells and 32 T-071A seeds
descriptive_criteria.P2: at least 7 percent nonstationary geometric cumulative-risk improvement
descriptive_criteria.P3: strict improvement in at least 55 percent of nonstationary cells
descriptive_criteria.P4: at least 3 percent improvement in both nonstationary schedules
descriptive_criteria.P5: at least 3 percent improvement in every delay group
descriptive_criteria.P9: exactly 240 learning transitions, zero extra probes, at most 18 messages
descriptive_criteria.P10: mean rho upper is larger and effective sample size is smaller for temporal correlation 0.9 than 0
descriptive_criteria.P11: positive continuous collaboration, finite debt, and mean QP iterations at most 35
